snippet.title: Whispered Scrolls | Official Trailer | Free Fantasy Action MMO
snippet.description:
Six Scrolls were shattered. The seventh was never found.

Whispered Scrolls is a free fantasy MMO with skill-based action combat. There's no tab targeting. Aim every block, arrow, spell, and strike, master 20 skills, and follow the Whispers across Aethermere with friends.

Play free: https://whisperedscrolls.com
Join the discussion on Discord: https://discord.gg/ERJmmVutFa

What's in the game
• A huge living world played with hundreds of players simultaneously.
• 21 unique weapon styles across five combat skills, with no classes. The weapon in your hand decides what you train.
• 20 skills to master, all the way to 99: fight, gather, craft, and explore everything all on one character.
• Party up with tanks, healers, and damage dealers to plunder 21 dungeons and conquer world bosses in the wild.
• 166 quests with riddles, mysteries, and real choices.
• Craft your own gear and trade on a market shared by every world.

Plays in your browser on Chrome or Edge, or download it for Windows. Needs a keyboard and mouse.

Whispered Scrolls is in open alpha and in active development, so expect rough edges and plenty of change. Every shot in this trailer was captured in-game.
